entries.title: Psalms 81:1
segments: A song for the festival of the passover.  See note to

. 
 
The praise of God forms an important part of the business of his people, and while it honors him, it enlivens, invigorates, and sanctifies their own souls.

entries.title: Psalms 81:3
segments: In the new moon; this was done at the beginning of every month,
But the beginning of the month Abib, being also the beginning of the year,

, would naturally be observed with peculiar solemnities. 
 
  In the time appointed; or, at the full moon, as the Hebrew word seems to signify.  The passover was eaten on the fourteenth day of the month Abib, consequently at the full moon.

entries.title: Psalms 81:5
segments:
This; the solemn feast spoken of above, the feast of the passover. 
 
  In Joseph; among the Israelites. 
 
  Testimony; a perpetual witness of the deliverance of Israel. 
 
  A language that I understood not; the language of a foreign people, the Egyptians.

entries.title: Psalms 81:6
segments: The burden--the pots; the hard service in brick and mortar.

entries.title: Psalms 81:7
segments:
The secret place of thunder; the cloud which encompasses God's throne, whence proceed thunderings and lightnings. 
 
God is ever ready to hear and answer those who in sincerity and truth call upon him, and to grant them the blessings which they need.  Let them hearken unto him, and they shall not want any good thing.

entries.title: Psalms 81:10
segments:
Open thy mouth; enlarge thy desires. 
 
  I will fill it; give abundance of blessings.

entries.title: Psalms 81:12
segments: The reason why any are ever left of God to hardness of heart and blindness of mind, to follow their own inclinations to their ruin, is, they choose not to walk in his ways.

entries.title: Psalms 81:13
segments: God sincerely and earnestly desires the salvation of men, and is greatly dishonored and grieved when they refuse to obey him, and thus cut themselves off from his blessing, when by obedience they might through grace secure all needed good for this life and the life to come.

entries.title: Psalms 81:15
segments: Their time; the time of his people's prosperity.

entries.title: Psalms 81:16
segments: Fed them--with the finest of the wheat; given them the richest blessings.
